Closing Tools — Guarantor Forms & Lease

MySpace NYC · Closing

Enter the deal info once — download filled guarantor agreements (one per guarantor), the filled SD Management lease, and the congrats/payment email. All signature and notary areas stay blank for signing.

Deal / Apartment

Guarantor form:

Guarantors

    Lease — SD Management (Rent Stabilized)

    Uses the deal info above: Tenant(s), Owner (landlord), apartment address, monthly rent, security deposit, Date (lease date), and Lease commencing (beginning). Fills the cover page, the “rent checks payable to” line, and the flood rider names. All signature lines stay blank for DocuSign.

    Congrats / Payment Email

    The address, lease dates, and payment amounts update automatically as you fill in the deal info above. You can also edit the text directly — if you do, it stops auto-updating so your edits aren't lost; hit “↺ Update from deal info” to re-sync. Attach the guarantor agreement PDF(s) when you send it.

    Each guarantor gets their own filled agreement (their name appears in the “My name is” line and the bottom Guarantor Name box). The Address, Signature, and Notary areas are left blank for the guarantor to complete. Fields stay editable in Adobe / Preview in case anything needs a tweak. Nothing is uploaded anywhere — the PDFs are created right in this window.
